name: UWA Guild Unpaid Placement (UP) Grant
summary: Grant of up to $300 for UWA Guild members in hardship doing a mandatory unpaid placement that cuts their paid work.
who: Currently enrolled at UWA and a Guild member
Severe financial hardship and unable to repay a Guild loan
Doing an unpaid placement that is mandatory for your course and has affected your paid work
how: Download and complete the UP Grant form
